description: Revalidate Selaras HTML and mutable deployment data
expression: http.host eq "selarasui.my.id" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.response.content_type.media_type eq "text/html" or http.request.uri.path eq "/_nuxt/builds/latest.json" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_payload.json") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/__nuxt_content/"))
